hooks.comment: Fix A: Phase staging文件写入时字符硬门控(>=15K) + Complete文件写入时字符硬门控(>=100K)
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in */staging/*.md) CHARS=$(echo -n "$CONTENT" | wc -m | tr -d ' '); if [ "$CHARS" -lt 15000 ]; then echo "BLOCK: Phase staging文件字符数=${CHARS} < 15000最低要求。请扩写到>=15K后再写入。" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0 ;; *_Complete_*.md|*_Complete*.md) CHARS=$(echo -n "$CONTENT" | wc -m | tr -d ' '); if [ "$CHARS" -lt 100000 ]; then echo "BLOCK: Complete文件字符数=${CHARS} < 100000绝对底线。Tier 3报告不可低于100K字符。" >&2; exit 2; fi; ISSUES=0; echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qiE '^#+.*Phase [0-9]' && ISSUES=$((ISSUES+1)) && echo 'ERROR: Complete含Phase标题' >&2; echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qE 'DM-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+' && ISSUES=$((ISSUES+1)) && echo 'ERROR: Complete含DM锚点' >&2; echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qi '入侵' && ISSUES=$((ISSUES+1)) && echo 'ERROR: 第零律违反' >&2; echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qi '减仓\|加仓\|全部卖出' && ISSUES=$((ISSUES+1)) && echo 'ERROR: 铁律P违反' >&2; if [ "$ISSUES" -gt 0 ]; then echo "BLOCK: 无痕化检查${ISSUES}项违反" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

hooks.comment: 检查md文件中的断链引用
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in *.md) grep -oE '`(docs/[^`]+|[A-Z]+\.md|\.claude/skills/[^`]+)`' "$FP" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '`' | while read ref; do [ ! -f "$ref" ] && echo "WARNING: 断链引用 $ref 在 $FP 中" || true; done || true ;; esac; true

hooks.comment: Fix B: 报告路径检查(PostToolUse仅信息提示，阻断已移至PreToolUse)
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$FP" in */reports/*.md) case "$FP" in */reports/*/[A-Z]*) echo "报告路径正确: $FP" >&2 ;; *) echo "WARNING: 铁律E — 报告应放入 reports/{TICKER}/ 子目录" >&2 ;; esac ;; esac; exit 0

hooks.comment: Fix C: Phase完成后强制评估提醒(含字符量检查)
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); case "$CMD" in *phase_complete*) echo ''; echo '=== EVALUATOR CHECKPOINT ==='; echo 'Phase完成。在继续下一Phase前，必须:'; echo '1. 运行Evaluator对本Phase产出进行独立评估'; echo '2. Evaluator verdict必须为PASS才能继续'; echo '3. 执行 wc -m 验证staging产出字符数是否达标'; echo '4. 检查Sprint Contract char_budget达成率'; echo '=== END CHECKPOINT ===' ;; esac; exit 0
